title: Classes of offenses.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided, offenses against the election laws contained in this title are divided into two classes: "election frauds" and "misdemeanors".
bodyHtml: §19-1  Classes of offenses.  Except as otherwise provided, offenses against the election laws contained in this title are divided into two classes:  "election frauds" and "misdemeanors". [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2]
